title: Schema: FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy on Game + GameSeries, SeriesJoinRequest model, data fix
description:
Product rule (from the user): a friends-only game/series has exactly two link modes, chosen by the manager — REQUEST_TO_JOIN (default): anyone with the link can VIEW it, but a non-friend's join becomes a request the manager must approve; BLOCKED: anyone who isn't a friend of the organizer (or already on it) can't even view it. Today's behavior (friends-only but fully open by link) must no longer exist.
Schema:
- `enum FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy { REQUEST_TO_JOIN BLOCKED }`.
- `Game.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy @default(REQUEST_TO_JOIN)` after `friendsOnlyUntil` (~361), with a `///` comment stating the rule above and that it only matters while the game is friends-only (isFriendsOnly && friendsOnlyUntil not passed).
- `GameSeries.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy @default(REQUEST_TO_JOIN)` after `isFriendsOnly` (~645).
- `enum SeriesJoinRequestStatus { PENDING REJECTED }` and `model SeriesJoinRequest { id String @id @default(cuid()); seriesId String; userId String; status SeriesJoinRequestStatus @default(PENDING); createdAt DateTime @default(now()); series GameSeries @relation(fields:[seriesId], references:[id], onDelete: Cascade); user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id], onDelete: Cascade); @@unique([seriesId, userId]); @@index([seriesId, status]) }` plus back-relation fields `joinRequests SeriesJoinRequest[]` on GameSeries and `seriesJoinRequests SeriesJoinRequest[]` on User. A separate table (not a PENDING status on SeriesParticipant) on purpose: every existing subscriber query (game generation in index.js, notifications, member counts in manage.js, profile groups in users.js) keeps meaning 'real member' without changes.
Migration SQL: CREATE TYPE for both enums, ADD COLUMN to "Game" and "GameSeries" (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN'), CREATE TABLE "SeriesJoinRequest" with FKs (ON DELETE CASCADE), unique + index. Data fix in the same migration: the weekly generator in server/index.js has always created games with isFriendsOnly=false even for friends-only series (step 7 fixes the code), so: `UPDATE "Game" g SET "isFriendsOnly" = true FROM "GameSeries" s WHERE g."seriesId" = s.id AND s."isFriendsOnly" = true AND g."start" >= now() AND g."isFriendsOnly" = false AND g."friendsOnlyUntil" IS NULL;`. Then `npx prisma generate`. Follow prisma-db.mdc (directUrl for migrate, enum sync).

title: Access helper: getGameAccess / getSeriesAccess + unit tests
description:
New CommonJS module, takes `prisma` as first arg (same style as utils/friends.js), returns one of 'FULL' | 'REQUEST' | 'NONE'.
`areFriends(prisma, a, b)`: `prisma.friendship.findFirst({ where: { OR: [{ userAId: a, userBId: b }, { userAId: b, userBId: a }] }, select: { id: true } })`.
`isGameFriendsOnlyNow(game)`: `game.isFriendsOnly && !(game.friendsOnlyUntil && new Date(game.friendsOnlyUntil) <= new Date())` (mirrors gameService.isPubliclyVisible).
`getGameAccess(prisma, game, viewerId, { isAdmin = false } = {})`: not friends-only-now => 'FULL'. Otherwise 'FULL' if isAdmin, viewer is organizer, viewer has ANY Participation row on the game (any status, incl. PENDING/REJECTED — use `game.participants` if loaded, else query), viewer has a GameRole on the game (use `game.roles` if loaded), viewer is a SeriesParticipant of `game.seriesId` (if set), or viewer is a friend of the organizer. Else `game.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy === 'BLOCKED' ? 'NONE' : 'REQUEST'`. Anonymous viewer (no viewerId) on a friends-only-now game => 'NONE' if BLOCKED else 'REQUEST'. Short-circuit in cheap-first order so most calls do zero extra queries.
`getSeriesAccess(prisma, series, viewerId, { isAdmin = false } = {})`: `!series.isFriendsOnly` => 'FULL'. Else 'FULL' if isAdmin, organizer, SeriesParticipant of the series (any role), or friend of the organizer; else BLOCKED ? 'NONE' : 'REQUEST'.
Also export `seriesVisibilityWhere(viewerId)` for list queries: no viewer => `{ isFriendsOnly: false }`; else `{ OR: [{ isFriendsOnly: false }, { organizerId: viewerId }, { subscribers: { some: { userId: viewerId } } }, { organizer: { OR: [{ friendshipsA: { some: { userBId: viewerId } } }, { friendshipsB: { some: { userAId: viewerId } } }] } }] }` (same shape as gameService.buildVisibilityWhere; verify the GameSeries.organizer relation name).
Unit tests with a hand-rolled prisma mock (no DB): every branch of both functions, incl. friendsOnlyUntil in the past => FULL, anonymous + REQUEST_TO_JOIN => REQUEST, anonymous + BLOCKED => NONE, participant with status REJECTED => FULL, series member => FULL on the series' game.
Series members (SeriesParticipant of game.seriesId) get FULL on every game of that series, including the ~4 future games that already exist when they are approved into the series: joining the series never adds them to games, but they can then join any series game like a friend (the game's own joinPolicy applies, no forced request).

title: Game read + settings: gate GET /games/:id, viewer-specific approval, editable policy
description:
(a) `getGameById(gameId, viewerId, { isAdmin } = {})` (~2017): after the 404, `const access = await getGameAccess(prisma, game, viewerId, { isAdmin });`. 'NONE' => `throw httpError('This game is for friends only', 403, { code: 'GAME_FRIENDS_ONLY' })` BEFORE the chat self-heal (check httpError ~80 + handleRouteError so `code` ends up in the JSON body). Otherwise `const dto = mapGameForClient(game, viewerId)`; when access === 'REQUEST' set `dto.joinPolicy = 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL'` and `dto.viewerJoinRequiresApproval = true` (this response is per-viewer, so existing web/mobile UI already shows 'request to join' instead of 'join'); else `dto.viewerJoinRequiresApproval = false`.
(b) `mapGameForClient` (~164): add `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy: game.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy || 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN'`.
(c) Accept `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` in `patchGame` (~1546/1614) and `updateGame` (~1681/1739); only accept the two enum strings, ignore anything else.
(d) `createGame` (~683): destructure `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy`; effective value = valid payload value, else `series?.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy`, else 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN' (same pattern as effectiveIsFriendsOnly ~761). Write it on every `prisma.game.create` that sets isFriendsOnly (~877, ~928, ~972, ~1062) and on the series created there (~887 area: wherever the GameSeries row is created with isFriendsOnly). `convertGameToSeries` (~1330, ~1401): copy `existing.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` to the series and its games.
(e) routes/games.js ~177: pass `{ isAdmin: !!req.user?.isAdmin }`.
Do NOT touch buildVisibilityWhere — feeds already hide friends-only games and that stays as is.

title: Game join: block (BLOCKED) or force a join request (REQUEST_TO_JOIN) for non-friends + tests
description:
POST /:id/join (~38): load the game with `participants` and `roles`. After the CANCELLED check, `const access = await getGameAccess(prisma, game, req.user.id, { isAdmin: !!req.user?.isAdmin })`. 'NONE' => 403 `{ error: 'This game is for friends only', code: 'GAME_FRIENDS_ONLY' }` before any write. `const forceApproval = access === 'REQUEST';` Change the approval branch condition (~87) to `(forceApproval || (game.joinPolicy === 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL' && !game.lotteryEnabled)) && game.organizerId !== req.user.id` so a non-friend always lands in PENDING, also on lottery games (lottery handling on approval is below). The existing-row handling above it stays as is (a REJECTED non-friend gets the existing 'declined' error).
Integration test (supertest + dev DB, pattern from testing-jest.mdc / friendsFlow.test.js): organizer O, friend F, stranger S. Friends-only game, REQUEST_TO_JOIN: GET as S => 200 with `viewerJoinRequiresApproval: true` and joinPolicy REQUIRES_APPROVAL; GET anonymous => 200; S joins => response `pending: true`, Participation is PENDING; F joins => CONFIRMED (game joinPolicy INSTANT). BLOCKED: GET as S => 403 GAME_FRIENDS_ONLY; anonymous => 403; S join => 403 and no Participation row; F => 200; O => 200; a stranger with an existing Participation row => 200. friendsOnlyUntil in the past + BLOCKED => S gets 200 and joins instantly. Public game => unchanged. PATCH by O with `{ friendsOnlyLinkPolicy: 'BLOCKED' }` persists and is echoed. Clean up in afterAll. Run: `cd server && PORT=3099 npx jest tests/friendsOnlyGameLink.test.js --runInBand --detectOpenHandles --forceExit`.
Lottery rule (from the user): if the game has a pending lottery, an approved request must ENTER THE LOTTERY, not take a seat directly. (1) In the join route, for forceApproval on a lottery game with `!game.lotteryExecutedAt`, apply the same window checks the lottery-join path already does (~104-112: no lotteryAt => 400, now >= lotteryAt => 400 "Lottery window is closed") BEFORE creating the PENDING row. (2) In POST /:id/join-requests/:userId/approve (~251-283): `const lotteryPending = game.lotteryEnabled && !game.lotteryExecutedAt;` then `newStatus = lotteryPending ? 'WAITLISTED' : (confirmedCount < game.maxPlayers ? 'CONFIRMED' : 'WAITLISTED')`. WAITLISTED is the lottery pool: gameScheduler._runLottery (~178-204) shuffles WAITLISTED into the remaining seats. Skip sendAutoWelcomeMessage when not CONFIRMED (already the case). Still add them to the chat as today. This also applies to an existing REQUIRES_APPROVAL+lottery game, which is correct. Tests: non-friend requests on a lottery game before lotteryAt => PENDING; approve => WAITLISTED even with free seats; request after lotteryAt (not executed) => 400; after the lottery ran, approve => CONFIRMED when there is room. Also: a series member (SeriesParticipant) who is not a friend joins an already-existing friends-only BLOCKED series game => 200 with the game's normal joinPolicy.

title: Series read/list/settings: hide friends-only series, gate GET /series/:id, editable policy
description:
Today GET /series/active lists friends-only series to everyone, and GET /series/:seriesId has no auth middleware at all.
(a) GET /active (~126): add `...seriesVisibilityWhere(req.user?.id)` to the where (combine with `isActive: true` via AND).
(b) GET /:seriesId (~184): add `attachOptionalUser`. After resolving the series (incl. the gameId fallback), `const access = await getSeriesAccess(prisma, series, req.user?.id, { isAdmin: !!req.user?.isAdmin })`; 'NONE' => 403 `{ error: 'This group is for friends only', code: 'SERIES_FRIENDS_ONLY' }`. Add to the payload: `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy`, `viewerAccess` ('FULL' | 'REQUEST'), `viewerJoinRequestStatus` (PENDING/REJECTED/null from SeriesJoinRequest for the viewer), and for viewers who pass `canManageSeries` a `pendingJoinRequestCount`.
(c) PATCH /:seriesId (~339): accept `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` (two enum values only) into `data` (~463), and propagate to future games `gd.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` next to `gd.isFriendsOnly` (~536).
Test (supertest + dev DB): friends-only series by O, BLOCKED: /active as S does not include it, as F does, anonymous doesn't; GET /:id as S => 403 SERIES_FRIENDS_ONLY, as F/O/member => 200. REQUEST_TO_JOIN: /active as S still excludes it (hidden from lists exactly like games), GET /:id as S => 200 with viewerAccess 'REQUEST'. Public series unchanged. PATCH policy persists and propagates to a future game. Run only this file.

title: Series join requests: subscribe => request for non-friends, approve/reject endpoints + tests
description:
POST /:seriesId/subscribe (~299): compute getSeriesAccess. 'NONE' => 403 SERIES_FRIENDS_ONLY. Already a SeriesParticipant => `{ ok: true }` (idempotent, as today). 'REQUEST' => if a REJECTED SeriesJoinRequest exists => 400 `{ error: 'Your request to join this group was declined', code: 'SERIES_JOIN_DECLINED' }`; else upsert a PENDING SeriesJoinRequest, notify the organizer (notificationService.sendNotification, type GAME_JOIN_REQUEST, Hebrew title/body like 'בקשת הצטרפות לקבוצה' / '<name> ביקש/ה להצטרף לקבוצה <title>', data `{ seriesId, userId, actorId, link: '/series/<id>' }`; first check how web + mobile route a tapped notification — if they route by `data.link`, reusing the existing type is enough; if they route GAME_JOIN_REQUEST by gameId, add a `seriesId` branch there instead and flag it as an extra step) and return `{ ok: true, pending: true }`. 'FULL' => existing behavior.
DELETE /:seriesId/subscribe (~324): also delete the viewer's PENDING request (lets them cancel it).
New endpoints (all `authenticateToken` + `canManageSeries`, 403 otherwise): GET /:seriesId/join-requests => `{ pending: [...], rejected: [...] }` each `{ userId, name, avatar, createdAt }`; POST /:seriesId/join-requests/:userId/approve => in one `prisma.$transaction`: upsert SeriesParticipant MEMBER + delete the request; notify the requester (GAME_JOIN_APPROVED, link to the series); POST /:seriesId/join-requests/:userId/reject => set status REJECTED, notify (GAME_JOIN_REJECTED). Approving NEVER adds them to any game (series membership never does). Because getGameAccess treats series members as FULL, an approved member can join every game of the series, including the ~4 already-generated future ones. No lottery logic here: series have no seat limit.
Test: S subscribes to REQUEST_TO_JOIN series => pending, no SeriesParticipant; F subscribes => member immediately; O approves S => member, request gone; reject path => S re-subscribe gets SERIES_JOIN_DECLINED; non-manager calling approve => 403; BLOCKED series => S subscribe 403. Mock notificationService as other tests do. Run only this file. Extra test: after approval, S can join an already-existing future game of that series (BLOCKED or REQUEST_TO_JOIN) without a forced request.

title: Weekly series game generator: copy friends-only settings from the series
description: The occurrence generator (~1155-1170) hardcodes `isFriendsOnly: false`, so every auto-generated game of a friends-only group was public. Replace with `isFriendsOnly: !!s.isFriendsOnly`, add `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy: s.friendsOnlyLinkPolicy || 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN'` and `joinPolicy: s.joinPolicy || 'INSTANT'`. Leave the other hardcoded fields (lottery etc.) alone — out of scope. Verify the series query that feeds this loop selects those columns (if it uses `select`, add them). No new test file (index.js boots the server); the column copy is covered by reading the diff, and the gate is the existing server test run for files touched in steps 2-6.

title: Shared types + web API clients
description:
shared/types/game.ts: `export type FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy = 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN' | 'BLOCKED';`, add `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy?: FriendsOnlyLinkPolicy;` and `viewerJoinRequiresApproval?: boolean;` to the game type (~74). Follow shared-types.mdc (shared/ is the source of truth; don't redeclare in next_app/mobile_app).
next_app series.ts: add `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy`, `viewerAccess`, `viewerJoinRequestStatus`, `pendingJoinRequestCount` to the series details type; subscribe returns `{ ok, pending? }`; add `getSeriesJoinRequests(id)`, `approveSeriesJoinRequest(id, userId)`, `rejectSeriesJoinRequest(id, userId)` using the existing apiClient pattern.
next_app games.ts: make sure the create/update payload types accept `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` (only if they are explicitly typed).

title: Web: friends-only mode picker in the game editor + locked state on the game page
description:
useGameEditor: `initialFriendsOnlyLinkPolicy` (default 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN'), state + setter, send `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` in both save payloads next to isFriendsOnly (~236, ~303).
GameDetailsEditor: inside `<Collapse in={state.isFriendsOnly}>` (~339), above 'make public later', a RadioGroup with two options:
  • 'קישור פתוח, הצטרפות באישור' (default) — 'מי שמקבל את הקישור יכול לראות את המשחק ולבקש להצטרף. חברים שלך מצטרפים כרגיל.'
  • 'קישור חסום למי שאינו חבר' — 'רק חברים שלך ומי שכבר במשחק יוכלו לפתוח את הקישור.'
Match the Paper/FormControlLabel styling already there.
page.tsx: add the two fields to the local Game type (~58), pass `initialFriendsOnlyLinkPolicy` next to `initialIsFriendsOnly` (~198). `fetchGame` (~71) returns null on any non-ok: make it return a discriminated result so a 403 with `code === 'GAME_FRIENDS_ONLY'` renders an info Alert 'המשחק הזה פתוח לחברים של המארגן בלבד' (+ for signed-out viewers: 'אם אתה חבר של המארגן, התחבר כדי לראות אותו'), keeping 'המשחק לא נמצא' for everything else. If the page has generateMetadata, it must handle the forbidden result without leaking the title. When `viewerJoinRequiresApproval` is true, check the join CTA shows the request-to-join wording (it should, since joinPolicy comes back REQUIRES_APPROVAL); fix only if it doesn't, and only within these files.

title: Web: mode picker when creating a game
description: Wherever the create flow shows the friends-only switch, show the same two-option RadioGroup (same copy as step 9) when it's on, default 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN', and send `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` in the create payload next to isFriendsOnly. When creating a game inside a series and the user didn't touch it, omit the field so the server inherits the series value. If NewGameInline or games/new/page.tsx turn out not to render the friends-only switch, leave that file untouched.

title: Web: series settings mode picker + series page locked state
description:
useSeriesSettingsEditor/SeriesSettingsEditor: same two-option picker shown when the group is friends-only (copy as step 9 with 'קבוצה' instead of 'משחק', e.g. 'מי שמקבל את הקישור יכול לראות את הקבוצה ולבקש להצטרף'), send `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` in the PATCH, note it applies to future games too (the server propagates).
series/[id]/page.tsx: `fetchSeries` (~81) currently sends no token — use Clerk `auth().getToken()` like games/[id]/page.tsx so friends/members are recognized. 403 `SERIES_FRIENDS_ONLY` => info Alert 'הקבוצה הזו פתוחה לחברים של המארגן בלבד' (+ sign-in hint when signed out); keep not-found for the rest. Pass `initialFriendsOnlyLinkPolicy` next to `initialIsFriendsOnly` (~183) and pass `viewerAccess` / `viewerJoinRequestStatus` / `pendingJoinRequestCount` down to the components step 12 updates.

title: Web: series subscribe button pending state + manager join-request list
description:
SeriesSubscribeButton: when `viewerAccess === 'REQUEST'` label is 'בקשת הצטרפות'; after subscribing with `pending: true`, or when `viewerJoinRequestStatus === 'PENDING'`, show disabled 'הבקשה נשלחה' with a 'ביטול בקשה' action (DELETE subscribe); REJECTED => disabled 'הבקשה נדחתה'.
SeriesMembersPanel (managers only): a 'בקשות הצטרפות' section above the members list, using getSeriesJoinRequests, each row avatar + name + 'אשר' / 'דחה' buttons; on approve, refresh the members list. Hide the section when there are no pending requests. Reuse the visual pattern of the game join-requests list if one exists in next_app (grep 'join-requests').

title: Mobile: API clients + i18n strings
description:
series.ts: same additions as web step 8 (fields, `{ ok, pending? }`, getSeriesJoinRequests / approve / reject). Check mobile_app/src/services/api/games.ts; if its create/update payloads are explicitly typed, the type comes from shared (step 8), no edit needed there.
i18n keys (he + en): `friendsOnly.linkPolicyTitle` 'מי יכול להיכנס דרך קישור?'; `friendsOnly.requestToJoin` 'קישור פתוח, הצטרפות באישור'; `friendsOnly.requestToJoinHint` 'מי שמקבל את הקישור יכול לראות ולבקש להצטרף. חברים שלך מצטרפים כרגיל.'; `friendsOnly.blocked` 'קישור חסום למי שאינו חבר'; `friendsOnly.blockedHint` 'רק חברים שלך ומי שכבר בפנים יוכלו לפתוח את הקישור.'; `friendsOnly.gameLocked` 'המשחק הזה פתוח לחברים של המארגן בלבד'; `friendsOnly.seriesLocked` 'הקבוצה הזו פתוחה לחברים של המארגן בלבד'; `series.requestToJoin` 'בקשת הצטרפות'; `series.requestSent` 'הבקשה נשלחה'; `series.cancelRequest` 'ביטול בקשה'; `series.requestDeclined` 'הבקשה נדחתה'; `series.joinRequests` 'בקשות הצטרפות'; `common.approve`/`common.reject` only if they don't already exist. Natural English equivalents in en.json.

title: Mobile: mode picker in game edit + game create
description:
edit/[id].tsx: `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` state (default 'REQUEST_TO_JOIN'), load from data next to `setIsPrivate` (~237), two selectable rows (title + hint, using the step-13 keys) shown only when `isPrivate`, styled like the existing make-public-later block, and send it next to `isFriendsOnly: isPrivate` (~463).
useGameCreator + new.tsx: same picker when friends-only is on at creation, send `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` (omit when creating into a series and untouched, so the series value is inherited). mobile_app/src/hooks/useGameEditor.ts: only if edit/[id].tsx actually saves through it — then it's a 4th file, split it into its own step instead of growing this one.

title: Mobile: locked state on the game screen
description: `fetchGame` (~99): when the API answers 403 with `code === 'GAME_FRIENDS_ONLY'`, set a `forbidden` flag and render `t('friendsOnly.gameLocked')` instead of the not-found text (~250). Check how the mobile api client surfaces status/body on errors before writing the check. Verify that `viewerJoinRequiresApproval` / joinPolicy REQUIRES_APPROVAL makes the join CTA show request-to-join wording and the pending state after tapping; fix within this file only if not.

title: Mobile: series screen — settings picker, locked state, request-to-join, manager requests
description: fetchSeries (~84): 403 `SERIES_FRIENDS_ONLY` => locked message (`friendsOnly.seriesLocked`). Settings (~58/96/159): add `friendsOnlyLinkPolicy` state loaded from data, two-row picker shown when isFriendsOnly is on, include it in `changes` when it differs. Note the existing code sets `changes.isOpenToJoin = !isFriendsOnly` (~161) — leave that behavior alone. Subscribe button: same states as web step 12 (request / sent + cancel / declined). For managers (pendingJoinRequestCount > 0 or canManage): a 'בקשות הצטרפות' list with approve/reject using the step-13 client. If this file grows unwieldy, extracting a `SeriesJoinRequests` component into mobile_app/src/components/ is fine but makes it a 2-file step.
